description_en: Retrieves the lock diagnosis list for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例锁诊断列表
name: DescribeWaitingSQLRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值说明：
30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. If you do not specify this parameter, no start time is set, and all lock diagnosis information before the end time is returned. If the end time is also not specified, all lock diagnosis information is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 不填则表示没有查询开始时间，将返回查询结束时间之前所有锁诊断信息。如果也没有查询结束时间，将返回全部锁诊断信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. If you do not specify this parameter, no end time is set, and all lock diagnosis information after the start time is returned. If the start time is also not specified, all lock diagnosis information is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 不填则表示没有查询结束时间，将返回查询开始时间之后所有锁诊断信息。如果也没有查询开始时间，将返回全部锁诊断信息
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The username. If you do not specify this parameter, the lock wait information of all users is queried
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。不填则表示查询所有用户的锁等待信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition for the query. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}`: the top 10 queries with the longest wait time.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"LockWaiting"}`: queries that are waiting for locks.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"ResourceWaiting"}`: queries that are waiting for resources
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"10"}`：等待时间最长的10个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"LockWaiting"}`：锁等待的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"ResourceWaiting"}`：资源等待的查询
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en:
The sort field and sort order.

Default value: `{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`, which indicates that the results are sorted by start time in descending order. Other sort fields and sort orders are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段和排序方式。

默认为`{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`，表示按开始时间进行排序。暂不支持其他排序字段和排序方式
parameters.name: order

PID.description_en: The process ID, which is the unique identifier of the SQL statement for the waiting query
PID.description_zh: 进程ID，即等待查询SQL的唯一标识

SQLStmt.description_en: The SQL text of the query

SessionID.description_en: The ID of the session to which the query belongs

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。为时间戳格式，单位为ms

Status.description_en:
The wait status of the query. Valid values:

LockWaiting: The query is waiting for a lock.
ResourceWaiting: The query is waiting for resources
Status.description_zh:
查询的等待状态，取值如下：

LockWaiting：锁等待。
ResourceWaiting：资源等待

User.description_en: The user who executed the query

WaitingTime.description_en: The wait time of the SQL statement, in milliseconds
